title: SyncTray global settings file
description: Global app settings (~/.config/synctray/settings.json). Mirrors ONLY the enumerated keys of AppSettingsFileStore.SafeKey (on/off) and AppSettingsFileStore.StringKey (validated strings). Never contains secrets or telemetry identifiers (installationId, anonymousUserId). A running app applies an edit live; an edit made while the app is closed is applied at its next launch (except launchAtLogin). Also editable with `synctray settings set <key> <value>`.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

debugLoggingEnabled.description: Verbose debug logging for file watchers and sync triggers.

autoFixSyncIssues.description: Automatically run --resync when bisync detects an out-of-sync state.

launchAtLogin.description: Whether SyncTray starts automatically at login (SMAppService login item).

menuBarIconStyle.description: How the menu bar icon is drawn: color (blue while syncing, gray when idle), monochrome (the menu bar's own text color, highest contrast), or custom (the two colors below).

menuBarIconSyncingColor.description: The custom style's ring color while syncing, as #RRGGBB. Empty uses the default (system blue).

menuBarIconIdleColor.description: The custom style's ring color when idle, as #RRGGBB. Empty uses the default (gray).
